name: 85041 · Phoenix, AZ
findings: ZIP 85041 (Phoenix) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85041 (Phoenix) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85041 (Phoenix) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
